channel.title: Lake & McHenry County Scanner - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lake & McHenry County Scanner (lakemchenryscanner.com)

item.title: Hundreds attend protests throughout Lake County calling for the abolishment of ICE, honoring Renee Good
item.description: Hundreds of protestors gathered throughout Lake County over the weekend to call for the end of immigration operations in the U.S. after a woman was fatally shot by an ICE agent in Minnesota.

item.title: Suspect steals car, rams police squad and leads officers on 120 mph pursuit through Lake County
item.description: A suspect breaking into cars stole a vehicle and rammed a police squad, leading to a high-speed 120 mph pursuit that traveled through Lake County Sunday evening.

item.title: Beach Park firefighter-paramedic arrested on child endangerment charges after child battered in Waukegan
item.description: A Beach Park Fire Department lieutenant has been arrested on child endangerment charges after police say he threw a child onto a bed and battered the child in Waukegan.

item.title: Home invasion suspect claims he was buying drugs when dealer shot him, leading police to seize $500K cash, cocaine in Beach Park
item.description: A judge was unconvinced and ordered a home invasion suspect detained after he claimed he was invited into a home and then was shot by his drug dealer, who police found with $500K in cash and pounds of cocaine, in Beach Park.

item.title: Police investigating after suspects attempt to burglarize parked vehicles in Gurnee overnight
item.description: Police are searching for at least two suspects who were caught attempting to burglarize parked cars in a neighborhood in Gurnee during the overnight hours Tuesday.

item.title: Man accused of posing as home services worker, stealing $15,000 in cash from elderly woman's home in Crystal Lake
item.description: A Cook County man was arrested after allegedly posing as a home services worker and stealing $15,000 in cash once he gained access to an elderly woman's home in Crystal Lake.

item.title: 95-year-old man dies after SUV slams into his broken-down car, crashes into school bus in Deer Park
item.description: A 95-year-old man died after an SUV slammed into the rear of his broken-down car that he was working on and crashed into a school bus in Deer Park Tuesday afternoon.

item.title: 3 transported to hospital after teenager, adult and neighbor all fall through ice into lake near Cary
item.description: A teenager and an adult were rescued after they tried ice fishing and fell through the ice into a lake near Cary, resulting in a neighbor also falling through while attempting rescue Tuesday afternoon.

item.title: Emergency crews respond to many crashes after wind-driven snowfall brings dangerous conditions to Lake, McHenry counties
item.description: Emergency crews were actively responding to dozens of vehicle crashes across Lake and McHenry counties, including numerous school bus crashes, amid wind-driven snowfall.

item.title: 2 suspects accused of stealing over $20,000 worth of goods during multi-day crime spree at Gurnee Mills mall
item.description: Two suspects were arrested and authorities say they were responsible for stealing over $20,000 worth of merchandise during a multi-day crime spree at Gurnee Mills mall in Gurnee.
